rules.description: Detects a process opening a handle to lsass.exe — the core behavior behind LSASS memory credential dumping (Mimikatz, comsvcs.dll). Ported from Sigma rule lsass_credential_access.yml (T1003.001).

rules.displayName: Known C2 Framework Named Pipe Created
rules.description: Detects creation of named pipes matching default patterns used by common C2 frameworks (Meterpreter, Cobalt Strike, postex, MSSE-). Ported from Sigma rule c2_named_pipe.yml (T1071).
rules.query:
DeviceEvents
| where ActionType == "NamedPipeEvent"
| extend Fields = parse_json(AdditionalFields)
| where Fields.PipeName has_any ("meterpreter", "beacon", "cobaltstrike", "msagent", "postex", "MSSE-")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, Fields

rules.displayName: Remote Thread Created in Sensitive System Process
rules.description: Detects CreateRemoteThread targeting lsass, winlogon, explorer, services, or svchost — a classic process injection and credential-theft primitive. Ported from Sigma rule remote_thread_injection.yml (T1055).

rules.displayName: Unsigned DLL Loaded from User-Writable Path
rules.description: Detects loading of a DLL from a user-writable directory (Temp, AppData, Downloads) by a non-AV process — characteristic of DLL side-loading and injection from a staged payload. Ported from Sigma rule unsigned_dll_from_user_writable_path.yml (T1055.001). Note: DeviceImageLoadEvents does not expose signing status in this tenant; path-based heuristic used instead.
rules.query:
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\Downloads\")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("MsMpEng.exe", "SenseIR.exe", "msiexec.exe", "SgrmBroker.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256

rules.displayName: DNS Query to Suspicious Top-Level Domain
rules.description: Detects network connections on port 53 to destinations associated with TLDs disproportionately linked to malware C2 (.ru, .cn, .tk, .xyz, .top, .pw, .cc). Ported from Sigma rule dns_query_suspicious_tld.yml (T1071.004). DeviceDnsEvents is not available in this tenant; DeviceNetworkEvents with port 53 + RemoteUrl used instead.
rules.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where RemotePort == 53
| where RemoteUrl has_any (".ru", ".cn", ".tk", ".xyz", ".top", ".pw", ".cc")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("svchost.exe", "MsMpEng.exe", "backgroundTaskHost.exe", "SearchIndexer.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
